notes: Partition verified: all 22 source and all 35 target ids used exactly once; every head is a member of its array.
*the head of the cherubim* writes a *the* before construct and rectum alike, so nothing is fronted: the article takes the *the* before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one (rule 29).

*as it were* kept whole on the first כְּ, with the supplied copula joining the comparative predicate (rules 49, 20); the unit's note records the competing reading that puts *it were* on the following nominal.
